svg.title: OSI 7-layer model compared with ROS 2 Lyrical Luth
svg.text: OSI 7 layers vs ROS 2 Lyrical Luth
one message: encapsulate on the way down (TX), decapsulate on the way up (RX) · mapping is approximate
WHAT IS ON THE WIRE AT THIS LAYER
Notes: DDS-RTPS spans OSI 5–7 in practice; RTPS reliability (HEARTBEAT/ACKNACK) runs in user space over UDP.
SHM / loaned messages and rosidl::Buffer backends skip layers 1–4 between processes on the same host.
